introHtml: Klean Kanteen water bottles are made from high-quality stainless steel, offering durability and insulation for hot or cold drinks. For bulk buyers, these bottles provide a premium canvas for laser engraving or screen printing your logo. The 27 oz Eco Classic Sport Cap and 20 oz Insulated Classic are popular choices for corporate gifts, trade shows, and employee wellness programs. Their eco-friendly design aligns with sustainability goals, making them a smart choice for brands that value both function and environmental responsibility.
